tests.name: PostgREST-only routing: rest/v1 rewritten to the data host, auth/storage/functions/realtime untouched, pass-through when unset, real client wiring
tests.reason: On staging VITE_DATA_API_URL_STAGING is unset until the proxy's staging twin is live, so the build must behave exactly as before; the community-app smoke suite proves that on the deployed chunk. The routing itself is proven here without touching any server.

tests.name: Realtime routing (part 7a): unset = supabase.channel exactly as today; set = one RealtimeClient on VITE_REALTIME_URL with apikey + member token (setAuth on sign-in/refresh/sign-out), no call site reaches supabase.channel, no silent fallback; guard against direct channel calls
tests.reason: On staging VITE_REALTIME_URL_STAGING is unset until the self-hosted Realtime is live, so every channel must still open on Supabase exactly as before; the community-app smoke suite proves that on the deployed chunk. The routed path is proven here without opening any socket to a real server.
